description: Sanitized token counters from the initial GLM Free build, with a hypothetical same-usage Sol API price calculation. Not a measured Sol execution or subscription-bill saving.
checkpoint: Initial build ending at the 26.9K (13%) context indicator; later follow-up requests excluded
usageSource: Sum of completed Build assistant-message token counters in the local OpenCode session context API, through this checkpoint. No prompts, message/session IDs, plan text, credentials, or financial records are included.
assumptions: The same token counts are priced at Sol's Standard API rates; Sol was not run as a comparison executor.
The cache-aware estimate assumes the same cache-hit profile; it does not imply GLM cache entries transfer to Sol.
None of the recorded individual requests reached the 272K-input long-context price threshold.
Output and reasoning are separate counters in OpenCode and are added once for output pricing.
The all-input-uncached scenario reprices existing cached reads at the regular input rate; it is not an upper bound on a different executor's usage.
No Fast, Batch, Flex, regional processing, or separate paid hosted-tool charges are included.
Astra planning, the fixed subscription fee, and Jev classification are excluded from these build-only totals.
OpenAI OAuth subscription usage draws allowance; this API-equivalent estimate is not a cash invoice or a measured allowance saving.
